subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Historians argued that the road should be studied before the street was repaired.”?
options: On hot summer days, people in Maple City usually walk on the east side of Green Road.
The city created a glass-covered section in the sidewalk so people could see part of the old road while still walking safely above it.
When the station opened, commuters could see the wall behind glass while walking to trains.
The old man smiled and said, "A song does not stay in the air, but people still sing."
